description: This script automates the resolution of merge conflicts in package.json files, specifically for publisher, version, and icon fields, always choosing the HEAD version. It includes functions to check git repository status, identify conflicted files, parse conflict blocks, and resolve conflicts if only the specified fields are involved.

methods.name: isGitRepository
methods.description: Checks if the current directory is inside a git repository.

methods.name: getConflictedFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of files with merge conflicts.
